div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://dips.no/fhir/RetinaIntegration/CodeSystem/retina-conclusion-code-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: This examination is waiting to be graded by the AI system.
This examinations is waiting to be graded by a primary grader.
This examination is waiting to be graded by a secondary grader.
Patient should be scheduled for a new routine eye examination graded by primary grader or AI.
Patient should be scheduled for a new routine eye examination but graded by secondary grader.
Patient is leaving the screening program and should be referred to an ophthalmologist for further examination due to findings of diabetic retinopathy.

description.value: Codes for the current or final conclusion of the grading process (1000-series).
